activity_summary: You came into the bakehouse before the shoulder was out of the oven. The children were already on the subject of the pie's corner. Judith Sadler would not let them sit until the bench was wiped. Hamnet Sadler was still at the batch, and he told you the shoulder would come when it was ready. Nobody had yet put a loaf on the board.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Waited, ate, and left when the dinner was done.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Weighed the loaf, and said nothing about the hands.

entities.name: Judith Sadler
entities.context: Kept the house's pace, and sent the corner out in a cloth.

entities.name: Hamnet Sadler
entities.context: Set the shoulder and the loaf, and did not follow you down the lane.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Carried the cloth, and went ahead.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Argued the corner, and went ahead.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
